claim: Islands open ~March-October; monsoon mid-Oct to end-Feb shuts boats and ~95% of resorts.
quote: The islands are officially open from March to October. Outside of these months, the islands essentially shut down due to the monsoon season... Around 95% of resorts close for seasonal maintenance.

claim: Shared boat Kuala Besut-Perhentian RM40 one-way adult, ~40 min, last boat from jetty 17:00, returns 08:00/10:00/12:00/16:00; private boat RM450.
quote: One-Way Fares (Shared Boat): Adult RM40, Child RM25... Journey Time: Approximately 40 minutes... last boat departs at 17:00... Return: 08:00, 10:00, 12:00, and 16:00 (last boat)... Private Boat: Max 10 passengers RM450.

claim: Marine Park conservation charge: foreign adults RM30, foreign children/seniors RM15, paid at Kuala Besut jetty.
quote: Foreign Visitors (Non-MYKAD Holders): Adults RM 30.00, Children (6-12 years) and seniors (60+) RM 15.00. Malaysian Residents: Adults RM 5.00.

claim: One-way ferry ~RM35; guided half-day snorkel trip RM30-40; water taxis RM15-25 for most hops.
quote: The one-way ferry ticket from Kuala Besut to the islands is approximately 35 MYR per person... A guided half-day snorkeling trip costs around 30-40 MYR per person... Water taxis... costing around 15-25 MYR for most journeys.

claim: Secure attended parking near Kuala Besut jetty runs ~RM7-10 per day with 24h security.
quote: Parking rates normally range from RM 7 - RM 10 per day... safe parking available with 24-hour security guards... about 10 minutes walk from the jetty.

claim: Kota Bharu airport to Kuala Besut: taxi ~56 min, or a direct bus ~1h15.
quote: The fastest way... is by taxi, which takes 56 minutes... There is a direct bus departing from Kota Bharu Airport and arriving at Kuala Besut Jetty... journey takes approximately 1 hour and 15 minutes.

claim: Private taxi Kota Bharu airport to Kuala Besut jetty ~RM80-110, ~1 hour, max 3 pax.
quote: taxis are readily available at the airport with an estimated fare of around RM80 per way and about 1 hour's drive to Kuala Besut Jetty... maximum of 3 passengers per taxi.

claim: Shared Kota Bharu airport transfer to Kuala Besut ~RM30 per adult.
quote: Shared airport transfers are also available at RM30 per adult, which may be a more economical option than private taxis.

claim: Kuala Terengganu airport to Kuala Besut ~1h30 by taxi, ~RM110; shuttle van ~RM200.
quote: A taxi from the airport to Kuala Besut takes 1 hour 30 minutes. The taxi fare is RM110 per way... charter a shuttle van for RM200 per way.

claim: From KL: fly to Kota Bharu (~1h) then taxi/van to Kuala Besut and boat; or overnight bus.
quote: the fastest and easiest way is to fly from Kuala Lumpur to Kota Bharu, take a taxi or e-hailing ride to Kuala Besut Jetty, then take a speedboat to the island.

claim: Overnight bus KL (TBS) to Kuala Besut ~8-9h, ~RM45-60.
quote: Overnight buses from Terminal Bersepadu Selatan (TBS) in Kuala Lumpur go directly to Kuala Besut Jetty. The journey takes around 8-9 hours and costs MYR 45-60.

claim: Langkawi to Perhentian: no direct flight; connect via KL/Penang to Kota Bharu, or ferry to mainland + ~8h bus.
quote: There aren't any direct flights from Langkawi to Kota Bharu... ferry from Kuah in Langkawi to Kuala Perlis, then take a night bus from Kuala Perlis to Kuala Besut that departs at 8pm and arrives at 6am.

claim: Cameron Highlands to Kuala Besut is a ~6-hour direct bus; Langkawi requires connecting flights via KL.
quote: Getting to the Perhentian Islands from the Cameron Highlands is quite straightforward with a six-hour direct bus to Kuala Besut.

claim: Daily Tanah Rata (Cameron Highlands) to Kuala Besut bus, one 08:00 departure, ~RM80-104.
quote: daily bus from Tanah Rata (Cameron Highlands) to Kuala Besut Jetty for MYR 104... only one daily departure at 8am.

claim: NKS runs the Cameron Highlands-Kuala Besut shuttle (bookable, pay at Jerantut/agency).
quote: Kuala Besut Jetty (Perhentian Island) to Cameron Highland - NKS Hotel and Travel shuttle service.

claim: Kuala Tahan (Taman Negara) to Kuala Besut shuttle departs 08:00, ~7.5h, ~RM121-130, last boat held for transfer.
quote: bus transfer departs from the bus park in Kuala Tahan at 8:00 AM... arrive at Kuala Besut Jetty by 3:30-4:00 PM... shuttle currently costing RM130... last boat will be waiting for the transfer.

claim: Operator transfer links Taman Negara (Han Rainforest Resort) and the Perhentians.
quote: Taman Negara / Kuala Tahan - Perhentian Island transfer.

claim: No roads/cars on either island; water taxis ~08:00-18:00, fares negotiated; a paved jungle path links Long Beach and Coral Bay (10-15 min).
quote: Neither island has roads or vehicles... A jungle path connects Long Beach and Coral Bay, taking 10-15 minutes... Water taxis operate roughly from 8 AM to 6 PM... Lighting is poor by the water and along the beaches at night.

claim: Water-taxi fares ~RM20-30 short hops to RM50 longest routes; after ~19:00 prices roughly double, not all run after dark.
quote: Short hops like D'Lagoon to Long Beach... 20 to 30 ringgit... longest routes like Teluk Dalam to Coral Bay will cost 50 ringgit... after 7:00 PM, the price becomes double.

claim: Long Beach-Coral Bay jungle trail on Kecil is a short 10-15 min mostly-paved walk; monitor lizards common.
quote: the majority of this path is paved with concrete tiles... approximately a 10-15 minute walk... large monitor lizards, which are frequently seen near the path.

claim: No scheduled Perhentian-Redang link; overland route is boat to Kuala Besut, shuttle to Merang jetty, ferry to Redang (~4h).
quote: there is no direct connection from Perhentian Islands to Redang Island, but you can take the ferry to Kuala Besut... shuttle to Merang Jetty... then take the ferry to Redang Island. The fastest route... takes 3h 48m.

claim: Combined Redang + Lang Tengah snorkel day trip from Perhentian ~RM160 adult, 09:00-15:00, gear included.
quote: Adult (12+ years): RM160... Time: 09:00am from your resort on Perhentian... return around 2:30pm-3:00pm... Package Include boat trip and equipment (mask, snorkel & life jacket).

claim: A direct private charter Perhentian-Redang runs ~RM900/boat each way, ~45 min, weather-dependent.
quote: A private boat day trip from Perhentian to Redang costs RM900/boat/way with a journey of 45 minutes under normal weather conditions, available from March to October.

claim: Pulau Bidong housed tens of thousands of Vietnamese boat-people refugees 1978-1991 ("Little Saigon").
quote: Bidong Island... was a temporary home to tens of thousands of Vietnamese refugees from 1978 to 1991... known locally as Little Saigon.

claim: Bidong day trips run from Merang jetty (~10 nm; ~40 km from Kuala Terengganu), not from the Perhentians.
quote: Bidong Island is accessible from the coastal town of Merang... about 10 nautical mile of Merang jetty, in Setiu district. Merang jetty is about 40km from Kuala Terengganu town.

claim: Best window is late March-June: dry and quieter; Aug-Sep is peak crowds.
quote: the best time to go to Perhentian Islands is between late March and June, when it will be dry season but you won't have to deal with as many other tourists as you would during August and September.

claim: EUR/MYR traded around 4.5-4.7 in 2026 (~RM4.7 per euro used here).
quote: As of April 12, 2026, the Euro to Malaysian Ringgit exchange rate is 4.65... 30-day average of 4.6235.
